description: Replaces one AI receptionist’s procedures, named by id, with the whole list sent (at most 10). Each is a condition (when: party_size_over with people, service_is with service, or first_visit) and one to four steps in order (steps: ask with question, deposit_link with amount and currency, book, or hand_over). A deposit’s amount is the one written here; the AI does not set one. An empty list removes them all. Each change needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve. Owners and admins.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

procedures.description: The whole list, in order: each a condition (`when`) and one to four steps (`steps`) that follow it. It replaces the list there.

name: update_procedures
title: Change the AI receptionist’s procedures
